guidelines.detail: refines GW-03 (The generated model kept only one way to signal reorder and only one storage option, so the reference's alternative tasks, their split gateway and their merge gateway are missing (M1, M2, M5). The description states both alternatives with 'or' (S2, S5). The guideline is worded generically so it does not depend on this process's domain words.)

same as LRN-005 (The generated model keeps the split on the signal type but omits the task for one named signalling alternative (M1) and its flow into the merge gateway (F5). The description says 'an alert or check signals the need to reorder' (S2), so both alternatives must be modeled. LRN-005 already states this pattern for alternatives joined by 'or'. The documented guidelines (GW-03, FLOW-06) cover merges and )

same as LRN-005 (Two reference tasks have no counterpart: the 'manual alert' alternative of the reorder signal, and the 'storage' alternative of the placement step. The generator kept only one alternative in each place, merging the verb-sharing alternatives into a single task (for example 'shelves or in storage'). S2 and S5 state the 'or' alternatives explicitly, so the omission is a faithfulness error and not a v)

same as LRN-005 (The generated model omits the alternative task for the second means (M1) and lacks the exclusive merge gateways after the alternative inspection and placement paths (M4, M5), even though the description joins alternatives with 'or' and then continues the same way. LRN-005 already prescribes this pattern, and the previous guideline restates it, so the new wording only restates the existing learned )

same as LRN-005 (The generated model merged the two placement alternatives ('on shelves or in storage') into one task, so the reference's separate 'Place stock in storage' task has no counterpart (M2, P7, S5). For the signal step, the generated model relabeled the manual alternative as a stock check instead of the named manual alert, which produced the label mismatch (P2, M1, S2). Both are failures to apply LRN-00)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names two or more alternative ways to carry out the same step, joined by 'or' (for example, the step may be done by one of several named means), and the model would otherwise keep only one of them: Place an exclusive gateway before the alternatives. Give each named alternative its own task on a separate outgoing sequence flow from that gateway, using the action the description names for it. Merge the alternative branches with an exclusive gateway before the next described step. Do not drop any named alternative and do not leave the choice as one unconditional flow.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description names two or more alternative ways to carry out the same step, joined by 'or' (for example, the step may be done by one of several named means), and the model would otherwise keep only one of them
